text_blocks.snippet: Fidelity Union Life Insurance is a Dallas, Texas-based company that provides life insurance services to individuals and families. It was founded in 1927 by Carr P. Collins and William Morriss. The company was once ranked among the nation's ninety largest stock life insurance companies. The original headquarters was located in the Fidelity Union Life Insurance Building, now known as the Mosaic Dallas residential development. Fidelity Life, a separate entity, offers various life insurance products, including term and whole life policies, and is recognized as one of America's Best Insurance Companies by Forbes and Statista.
